hypothesis: Two or three separated closes beyond the same Bollinger band, with a return to the middle line between hits, may identify a persistent trend more reliably than a single band breakout.

research_provenance.author: Trendoscope (HeWhoMustNotBeNamed)
research_provenance.source_status: Author description available; open-source Pine not extracted or copied.
research_provenance.published_mechanism: Upper/lower band closes mark direction. A further hit of the same band counts only after price touches the middle band; consecutive walks count as one hit.
research_provenance.adaptations: Entry after second/third counted hit; exits at opposite qualified hit or middle-line cross; touch versus close-return definitions tested. These are research choices, not claimed author orders.

availability_lag: All OHLC, band and state values become actionable after the signal bar closes; order fills at next bar open.

entry_design.confirmation: middle return between counted closes outside the same band; two causal definitions tested
not_applicable: sub-hour intervals absent from frozen snapshot
unseparated band walking is one hit

parameter_rationale: 20 is the conventional Bollinger horizon and 30 checks a slower neighbor. Width is fixed at 2 standard deviations to isolate hit logic; 2/3 hits, two middle-return definitions, and two distinct exits form the complete declared grid. This is not a claim to search every conceivable setting. The fixed width is encoded as 20 in each variant ID rather than consuming a validator axis.
baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and timeframe, filled next open
signal_rule: After a completed close beyond upper/lower SMA+/-2 population-SD band, count first side hit. Count another hit of that side only if a previous completed bar returned to the middle by range touch or close crossing, as specified by variant. An opposite-band close resets the side and count. Enter after 2/3 hits at next open; exit/reverse by opposite qualified hit or exit at first adverse middle cross. No intrabar-order assumptions on bars touching middle and outer band together.
signal_semantics: Independent directional order for each symbol; no common-capital cross-sectional ranking.
evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual account per stock and interval.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Train-month ranking, then latest full 12m return >10% after model costs for each liquid stock; late history is seen, not an independent holdout.
limitations: No verified personal trade journal or exact Pine extraction
No dividends or splits in primary PnL

protocol_corrections.reason: Validator supports at most four varying axes; fixed sigma=2.0 was incorrectly listed as a fifth axis. Variant IDs and calculated signals are unchanged.
